base: Image 1 is a photo of this exact dog (likeness reference: round fluffy cloud head, long drop ears, dark eyes, button nose, happy tongue-out face). Image 2 is the matching chest emblem from the same apparel set. Create the BACK PRINT of the set: this dog's FULL BODY sitting upright and front-facing, head to paws, drawn in EXACTLY the same art style as image 2: same line weight, same stroke character, same black-and-white treatment, same level of detail, same face rendering, so the front emblem and this back print clearly belong together as one coherent design. Pure black ink on flat pure white background, no gray, no shading gradients, no texture, no ground line, no shadow, no frame, no collar. Generous empty margin on all sides. Crisp vector-like edges. Absolutely no text, letters, signature or watermark.
